title: Route Records
subtitle: Terminal memory for what the field taught you
summary: Route Records connect Lens discoveries, HoloMap markers, mission state, and the next useful What Now prompt.
body: After each route, return to shelter and check Terminal Route Records. This is where the next route should become clearer.
A route record should include the signal source, marker, risk label, reward reason, and whether the route is safe, optional, or future.
If a route record displays null text or a broken entry, capture it in smoke notes.
